DNS::drop
Description
This iRules command drops the current DNS packet after the execution
of the event.
Note: This command functions only in the context of LTM iRules and
requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled as part of GTM or the
DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
drop
DNS::drop
Drops the current DNS packet after the execution of the event.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
